newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha values seen $2 lower on screen.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha values seen $2 lower on screen.

text.p: NWE naphtha values fell back $2 on Monday on September swaps as brokers expected published physical quotes to also decline by $2.
The decline to $184.50-$185.25 was on a day of particularly thin trading when lower screen values in London and New York dictated the market direction.
Buyers and sellers were seen reluctant to enter the physical market, which was seen broadly balanced, according to brokers.
Rumours of a September swap trade at $185 remained unconfirmed.
